__doc: Floors per model for the share of memory cases the review got right (run.js --gate), as ratios.

eval-fake (the wiring smoke, every PR): the scripted model's one finding names no file of the case, so every quiet case is right and every flag case wrong. Deterministic: two runs on production's review stage gave the same answer on every case (5 of 10). floor = observed.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-16 from 2 local runs on parity/a-review-path 03bf13ba8, the review through production's stage (evals/shared/review-stage.js) with the memories written by KodyRulesService.createOrUpdate, the managed route: 9 and 9 of 10 (mean 90%), the same case wrong in both (config-read-through-config), so the paired per-case difference was 0 on every case. floor = mean - 2 binomial SE over the 10 cases (0.710), rounded down to a whole case: 7 of 10 still pass. Deliberate break (memories filtered out in KodyRulesValidationService, memoryRules=0 in all 10 prompts): 6 of 10, GATE FAILED, exit 1.
gpt-6-sol: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6: 9/10 and 9/10, mean 0.9. floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 1) / n) over n = 10, rounded down: 0.71.
claude-sonnet-5-5: calibrated 2026-10-17 from 2 local runs on a725253d6: 10/10 and 10/10, mean 1. floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 1) / n) over n = 10, rounded down: 0.9.
RATCHET: a PR that adds cases or moves the value on purpose recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.
